body.text: Scrollspy picks the section that contains the line just under the sticky chrome (header + sub-nav, re-read per callback) instead of the first intersecting section — adjacent sections both intersect the band, and the sub-nav publishes its height after mount; the probe also surfaced pre-existing 390px overflow (domain-search input min-width:auto, no-wrap trust tiles, 176px logo in a 390px header) fixed in the same commit
